S1.title: Hook: who will be the greatest archer?

S6.title: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away

lines.sequenceTitle: Hook: who will be the greatest archer?
lines.text: आखिर कौन बनेगा... पूरे राज्य का सबसे महान धनुर्धर?
lines.teachingGoal: Hook curiosity: a contest to find the greatest archer.
lines.onScreenObject: Five prince silhouettes with bows; a golden bow rising in the sky
lines.visualConcept: Question as image: who is THE archer?
lines.howShownVisually: Dawn. Camera glides right along five silhouettes standing on a ridge, each holding a bow lowered at his side. On 'कौन' each head lifts in a chain. On 'सबसे महान' a golden bow rises behind them like a sun. On 'धनुर्धर' it glows. THINK PAUSE: the silhouettes glance at each other; the golden bow curls and its arrow-tip drops beneath it, becoming a '?' symbol (bow curve + round dot).
lines.background: Dawn sky gradient cream→saffron, distant Hastinapur domes, ridge
lines.motion: Slow lateral glide 6 s; chained head lifts 120 ms apart; golden bow rise with soft overshoot; '?' forms over 600 ms then holds
lines.transitionOut: The '?' dot drops and becomes the rising sun of S2
lines.accuracyNotes: Hastinapur shown only as distant domes, not a specific real building.
lines.ageCheck: Abstract 'greatest' made concrete as a glowing prize-bow. No text.
lines.notes: Think pause 5.76–7.29 s holds a simplified frame.

views.princes x5: side, facing right (east, toward the sun)

lines.text: एक सुबह, गुरु द्रोणाचार्य ने सभी राजकुमारों को एक अनोखी चुनौती के लिए बुलाया।
lines.teachingGoal: Meet Guru Drona and the princes; set up the challenge.
lines.onScreenObject: Guru Drona; princes running in; the gurukul
lines.visualConcept: The guru calls, the students come
lines.howShownVisually: Reverse angle toward the ashram (C2): Guru Drona stands in the foreground (back view) facing the huts. On 'एक सुबह' the sun (left in this direction) rises over the ashram. On 'राजकुमारों' the princes run out toward camera and stop in a row; on 'चुनौती' Drona points up and every head follows. Then a sky-tilt carries us to the target field (C1).
lines.background: Gurukul clearing: thatched huts, mud wall, tall tree right of frame
lines.motion: Sun rise ease-out 1.2 s; princes run with cloth trailing and settle with a small bounce; heads tilt up together
lines.transitionIn: match ('?' dot → sun, sun is LEFT in C2)
lines.transitionOut: Camera tilts up following Drona's finger
lines.accuracyNotes: Drona as a Brahmin guru: white beard, top-knot, sandal tilak, rudraksha.
lines.ageCheck: Introduces characters by action, not name tags.

views.drona: back (foreground, facing the ashram as he calls)
views.princes: front, running toward camera → stop in a row

lines.text: एक ऊँचे पेड़ की डाल पर... एक छोटी सी लकड़ी की चिड़िया रखी थी।
lines.teachingGoal: Show the target clearly: a SMALL WOODEN bird high on a branch.
lines.onScreenObject: Tall tree, one long branch (डाल), the wooden bird
lines.visualConcept: Tilt up to the target; prove it's a toy
lines.howShownVisually: Camera tilts up the trunk on 'ऊँचे पेड़' (the tree feels very tall). On 'डाल' the long branch sways and a soft glow runs along it. Hold on '...'. On 'छोटी सी' a tiny shape sits at the branch tip; on 'लकड़ी की' a quick insert: a knuckle taps the bird, 'tok' lines, wood grain and a paint chip visible; on 'चिड़िया' back to the bird, which rocks stiffly on its peg.
lines.background: Sky, tree, branch against open sky
lines.motion: Tilt 1.5 s ease-in-out; branch sway spring; bird rocks like a heavy wooden toy
lines.accuracyNotes: Script says wooden bird: shown unmistakably as wood (grain, peg, base).
lines.ageCheck: Small target made readable: the bird stays in the upper-middle safe zone.
lines.notes: Safety: makes clear no real bird is involved.
lines.shot: tilt up past the trees, come down on C1

views.watchers (foreground): back, looking up at the tree

lines.text: "इस चिड़िया की आँख पर निशाना लगाना है!"
lines.teachingGoal: Name the exact target: the EYE.
lines.onScreenObject: Bird's painted eye; Focus Ring (first appearance)
lines.howShownVisually: Drona (mid-shot, mouth on his words) gestures to the bird. On 'चिड़िया' cut to the bird; on 'आँख' the golden Focus Ring draws itself clockwise around the painted eye and the eye gets a soft glint. On 'निशाना' Drona mimes an aim with empty hands.
lines.background: Morning sky; Drona in the foreground left
lines.motion: Ring draws in 500 ms then breathes subtly (±2%)
lines.ageCheck: One idea: the eye is the target.
lines.shot: mid on Drona → push to the bird
extras: focus ring first appearance on the eye

lines.text: सबसे पहले आगे आया... दुर्योधन!
lines.teachingGoal: Introduce Duryodhana as proud and pushy.
lines.howShownVisually: On 'सबसे पहले' the line of princes; Duryodhana shoulders his way to the front. On 'दुर्योधन' he plants his feet, chest puffs up, and his tall crown catches a gleam (a soft glint, not a flash).
lines.motion: Swagger walk with bouncy springs; crown wobble follow-through

views.duryodhana: back walking away from camera to the line → turns 3/4 → front on his name

lines.text: "हा हा हा! बस इतनी सी बात? ये तो मेरे बाएँ हाथ का खेल है!"
lines.visualConcept: Literal idiom: 'child's play with my left hand'
lines.howShownVisually: 'हा हा हा': head tips back, three laugh bounces exactly on the three laugh bursts (29.57/30.01/30.29 s); the extra chuckle continues the shoulders shaking. On 'इतनी सी' he pinches finger and thumb small toward the bird. On 'बाएँ हाथ' he lifts his LEFT hand and twirls the bow casually in it; on 'खेल' a careless shrug. Behind him two princes exchange a look.
lines.motion: Laugh bounces timed to bursts; bow twirl stays upright/away from others
lines.accuracyNotes: बाएँ हाथ = his left hand (viewer's right when facing camera).
lines.ageCheck: Idiom shown literally plus context makes it understandable.
lines.notes: The unscripted chuckle 31.21–32.35 s gets shoulder shakes only.
lines.shot: mid, small push on the laugh
extras: crown wobbles with each laugh bounce

lines.text: दुर्योधन ने अकड़कर अपना धनुष उठाया... और निशाना साधा।
lines.howShownVisually: On 'अकड़कर' chest inflates, chin lifts and the crown wobbles. On 'उठाया' the bow comes up. Hold on '...'. On 'निशाना साधा' he takes the aim pose pointed up at the tree, with one eyebrow raised.
lines.motion: Puff-up spring with overshoot; aim settles quickly (he's impatient)
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.

lines.text: गुरु द्रोणाचार्य ने पूछा...
lines.howShownVisually: Drona steps beside Duryodhana, one hand stroking his beard, head tilted. On 'पूछा' he leans in slightly.
lines.notes: Reused pose for L25 (repetition of format).

lines.text: "बताओ दुर्योधन, तुम्हें क्या दिखाई दे रहा है?"
lines.howShownVisually: Drona speaks (mouth synced). On 'तुम्हें' the camera pushes toward Duryodhana's face; on 'दिखाई' it reaches his eye and an iris-wipe opens into a circular POV window.
lines.motion: Push-in 1.2 s ease-in; iris open 400 ms
lines.transitionIn: iris (eye → POV) after the question ends
lines.shot: glide to his face → push to the eye

lines.text: "मुझे पेड़ दिख रहा है! उसकी डालियाँ दिख रही हैं! और चिड़िया भी!"
lines.onScreenObject: POV window: whole tree, branches, bird + clutter
lines.howShownVisually: Inside a wide POV circle that wobbles slightly: on 'पेड़' the whole tree pulses; on 'डालियाँ' every branch wiggles in turn; on 'चिड़िया भी' the bird pulses but is just one of many things. Leaves drift, a squirrel runs up the trunk, clouds slide: his eye darts (the circle drifts) between them. The Focus Ring is huge and loose around everything.
lines.motion: POV circle drifts ±30 px with gentle springs (no shake); pulses on nouns
lines.accuracyNotes: He names tree, branches and bird: exactly those three are highlighted, in order.
lines.ageCheck: Extra clutter is calm and slow to avoid overstimulation.

lines.text: "तो पीछे हट जाओ!"
lines.howShownVisually: POV iris closes. Drona's open palm rises, a slow head-shake; on 'पीछे' Duryodhana steps back into the line, bow lowered.
lines.motion: Calm palm rise; step back 400 ms
lines.transitionIn: iris (POV closes to a point → C1)
lines.ageCheck: Firm but kind, no shouting animation.

views.drona: 3/4 facing right, raised palm, slow head-shake
views.duryodhana: side facing LEFT, walks back to the waiting princes

lines.text: दुर्योधन का चेहरा गुस्से से लाल हो गया!
lines.teachingGoal: Show anger as a feeling, safely.
lines.howShownVisually: Close-up. On 'गुस्से' his brows drop; on 'लाल' a red tint rises inside his face from chin to forehead; two tiny comic steam puffs from his ears. Background stays calm.
lines.motion: Tint rises over 900 ms (no flash), steam puffs ease out
lines.ageCheck: No red full-frame wash; comic, short.

lines.text: उसने झल्लाकर अपना धनुष ज़मीन पर पटक दिया!
lines.teachingGoal: Show 'झल्लाकर' and that tantrums don't help.
lines.howShownVisually: On 'झल्लाकर' he stamps his foot with a huff. On 'पटक दिया' the bow drops flat to the ground with a small dust puff (nothing breaks). Drona's eyebrow lifts slightly; nearby princes lean back a little.
lines.motion: Bow thud with a small bounce; dust settles 700 ms
lines.transitionOut: Push past to the next prince
lines.ageCheck: Not glamorised; reaction shows it's not OK.
extras: crown slips over his eyes; he shoves it back up (gentle slapstick)

lines.text: अब बारी आई... युधिष्ठिर की।
lines.howShownVisually: Hold on '...'. On 'युधिष्ठिर' he steps forward and does a namaste to Drona, who nods.

views.yudhishthira: side facing right, walks to the line → 3/4 facing LEFT, namaste to Drona

lines.text: उन्होंने बड़े ध्यान से निशाना साधा...
lines.howShownVisually: On 'बड़े ध्यान से' he slowly raises the bow; on 'निशाना साधा' he settles into a steady aim. Hold on '...'.
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.

lines.text: लेकिन उन्हें भी पूरा पेड़ दिखाई दे रहा था!
lines.teachingGoal: What Yudhishthira sees: the WHOLE tree (calm but wide).
lines.howShownVisually: Quick push into his eye → POV window. Steady (no drift) but WIDE: on 'पूरा पेड़' the circle expands to hold the entire tree, which glows as one shape; the bird is tiny inside it.
lines.ageCheck: Contrast with L10: steadier but still wide.

lines.text: "तुम भी पीछे हट जाओ!"
lines.howShownVisually: Drona's palm (softer this time). On 'पीछे' Yudhishthira lowers his bow, bows his head and steps back calmly, the opposite of Duryodhana.

views.yudhishthira: 3/4 facing LEFT, bows head → side facing LEFT, walks back

lines.text: सभी राजकुमार एक-दूसरे का मुँह देखने लगे।
lines.teachingGoal: Build suspense: nobody knows the answer.
lines.howShownVisually: Reverse angle (C2) after a wipe as Bhima's broad back passes the lens: the princes' faces in a row with the ashram behind them. On 'एक-दूसरे' each prince's head turns toward his neighbour (3/4-left ↔ 3/4-right) in a chain, puzzled brows; Bhima shrugs.
lines.transitionIn: wipe-by-figure (Bhima's broad back passes the lens)

views.princes: front/3/4, heads swap left↔right to look at each other

lines.text: क्या ये चुनौती... सचमुच असंभव थी?
lines.teachingGoal: Was it impossible? Make the challenge feel huge.
lines.onScreenObject: Tiny bird against a huge sky; '?' symbol
lines.howShownVisually: Camera rises far above: the bird becomes a tiny dot at the branch tip in a vast sky. On 'असंभव' the frame holds. THINK PAUSE: the bow-shaped '?' glows faintly beside the bird.
lines.ageCheck: The answer comes immediately in L20.
lines.shot: extreme low angle up to the tiny bird

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: तभी... आगे बढ़ा अर्जुन।
lines.howShownVisually: On 'तभी' a single leaf drifts down through frame. Hold on '...'. The princes part; on 'अर्जुन' Arjuna steps forward from the back of the line, calm and unhurried.
lines.accuracyNotes: Arjuna shown dark-complexioned as in the traditional descriptions.

views.arjuna: side facing right, steps out from the waiting princes to the line

extras: a single leaf falls on तभी

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: पूरा मैदान... एकदम शांत हो गया।
lines.howShownVisually: Wide shot. 'पूरा मैदान': everything visible. Hold on '...'. On 'एकदम शांत' all secondary motion ramps to zero: leaves stop, birds settle, the princes freeze, and light cools slightly (still warm).
lines.motion: All motion eases to 0 over 800 ms
extras: all ambient motion ramps to zero (clouds, leaves, squirrel freezes mid-step)

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: अर्जुन ने अपना धनुष उठाया...
lines.howShownVisually: On 'उठाया' Arjuna lifts the bow slowly. Hold on '...'.
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.

views.arjuna: front aim, bow → right, sun rim-light

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: धीरे-धीरे प्रत्यंचा खींची...
lines.howShownVisually: Close-up on the bow. On 'धीरे-धीरे' fingers on the string; on 'प्रत्यंचा' a glint runs along the string from tip to tip; on 'खींची' the string draws back slowly and the bow flexes.
lines.shot: detail: bow + string, bow on the RIGHT

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: और अपनी साँस रोक ली।
lines.howShownVisually: Mid-shot in full draw. On 'साँस' his chest rises gently; on 'रोक ली' it holds; the last tiny motion in the world (a leaf's quiver, the sash's flutter) stops.
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: गुरु द्रोणाचार्य ने पूछा...
lines.howShownVisually: One continuous camera on the main stage (C1): Arjuna at full draw facing camera, aiming right at the small far tree; Guru Drona behind-left in 3/4, stroking his beard; waiting princes in the soft foreground (back views). On 'द्रोणाचार्य' the camera glides to the guru (the foreground princes ease away); on 'पूछा' he leans in toward Arjuna.
lines.shot: wide → glide to the guru as he is named

views.drona: 3/4 facing right, beard-stroke, leans in on पूछा
views.watchers (foreground): back, fade as the camera moves in

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: "अर्जुन... तुम्हें क्या दिखाई दे रहा है?"
lines.howShownVisually: Still the same camera: it holds on Drona (3/4, mouth on his words) for the whole question, then glides to Arjuna's focused face as '…है?' ends, and makes a short, gentle push toward his eye. His view opens from the eye just before he answers.
lines.shot: hold on Drona asking → glide to Arjuna's face as the question ends → short push

lines.sequenceTitle: Arjuna's turn: the world falls away
lines.text: "गुरुदेव... मुझे तो बस... चिड़िया की आँख दिखाई दे रही है।"
lines.teachingGoal: HERO: what Arjuna sees: ONLY the bird's eye.
lines.onScreenObject: POV: tree fades → bird → eye inside the Focus Ring
lines.howShownVisually: On 'गुरुदेव' the POV shows the full tree. On 'मुझे तो' the edges begin to blur. On 'बस' the tree, branches, leaves and sky soften and fade to pale paper; the POV circle tightens. On 'चिड़िया' only the bird remains, sharp. On 'आँख' the Focus Ring locks around the painted eye with a soft 'click' shimmer; the eye fills the circle like a bullseye and holds.
lines.motion: Progressive blur/desaturate 1.5 s; ring tightens with a slow spring and settles
lines.accuracyNotes: Popular retelling: he sees only the eye.
lines.ageCheck: Calm and clear; the strongest teaching frame.
lines.shot: POV: one steady zoom whole tree → bird → eye

lines.text: गुरु द्रोणाचार्य के चेहरे पर मुस्कान आ गई।
lines.howShownVisually: Close-up. On 'मुस्कान' Drona's mouth curves into a slow smile, his eyes crinkle, his beard lifts slightly.

lines.text: "तो फिर... बाण चलाओ!"
lines.howShownVisually: Drona nods. Hold on '...'. On 'चलाओ' a small nod and open-palm gesture toward the tree.
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.

lines.text: शूँऽऽऽ!
lines.howShownVisually: Main stage (C1), front view: on 'शूँ' the string snaps forward, the bow flexes, and the arrow streaks away to the RIGHT with a soft golden trail; the camera pans right with it into the sky (no cut).
lines.accuracyNotes: Arrows point only up/away at the wooden target; never at people or camera.
lines.shot: release, camera pans right with the arrow

lines.text: तीर हवा को चीरता हुआ आगे बढ़ा...
lines.howShownVisually: Follow-cam alongside the arrow: on 'हवा को चीरता' wind lines part around the tip and leaves swirl aside. Hold on '...' (slow-motion feel).

lines.text: और... सीधा चिड़िया की आँख में जा लगा!
lines.howShownVisually: Hold on 'और...' with the bird in the ring. On 'सीधा' the arrow flies in a straight line; on 'आँख' it 'tocks' into the painted eye; golden rings ripple outward from the eye (like target rings) and the bird rocks stiffly on its peg without breaking. Wood-chip sparkles.
lines.motion: Rings expand over 900 ms with fade (no flash); bird rocks with a heavy spring
lines.transitionIn: continuous (the bird enters from the right)
lines.ageCheck: Peak moment but calm; ≤3 ripple rings.

lines.text: सभी राजकुमार हैरान रह गए!
lines.howShownVisually: On 'हैरान' a jaw-drop chain left→right with round eyes; Duryodhana peeks, then looks away grumpily.

views.duryodhana: 3/4 facing LEFT, peeks then turns away

extras: squirrel jaw-drops too (on the ashram wall)

lines.text: उस दिन अर्जुन ने सबको एक बहुत बड़ी सीख दी।
lines.teachingGoal: Name the lesson as a gift.
lines.howShownVisually: Warm afternoon. Drona's hand on Arjuna's shoulder; princes gather in a semicircle. On 'बड़ी सीख' a small diya lights between them and glows softly.
lines.accuracyNotes: Diya as a symbol of knowledge (Indian context).

views.drona: 3/4 facing right, hand on Arjuna's shoulder

lines.text: महान बनने के लिए सिर्फ़ ताकत या घमंड नहीं...
lines.teachingGoal: Pride and strength alone are not enough.
lines.onScreenObject: Bhima lifting a log; Duryodhana inflating
lines.howShownVisually: On 'ताकत' Bhima lifts a heavy log easily and flexes. On 'घमंड' Duryodhana puffs up (his L5 pose) and his crown grows taller. On 'नहीं' both turn to soft grey silhouettes and step aside; Duryodhana deflates with a soft comic 'pfff'.
lines.motion: Inflate/deflate springs; fade to silhouette 500 ms
lines.ageCheck: ताकत shown as fine but not enough; घमंड clearly not the way.

lines.text: बल्कि चाहिए... अटूट एकाग्रता!
lines.onScreenObject: Arjuna's calm eye in the Focus Ring; butterfly and leaf
lines.howShownVisually: Close on Arjuna's focused eye. Hold on '...'. On 'अटूट' the Focus Ring forms and locks (thicker); a butterfly and a leaf drift in and gently bounce off the ring while the eye doesn't blink. On 'एकाग्रता' the ring glows warmly.
lines.motion: Distractions bounce with soft springs; ring stays rock-solid
lines.transitionIn: match (silhouettes part to reveal Arjuna's eye)
extras: butterfly and leaf bounce off the ring

lines.text: क्योंकि जब नज़र सिर्फ़ लक्ष्य पर हो...
lines.teachingGoal: Transfer: the same focus in a child's life.
lines.onScreenObject: A girl's eye → her room → a basket
lines.howShownVisually: Match-cut: the same ring now frames a girl's focused eye (same position). Pull back: her room, a crumpled paper ball in her hand, a wicker basket across the room. On 'लक्ष्य' the Focus Ring floats from her eye to the basket and settles around it. A kite outside the window drifts by and she ignores it.
lines.background: Modern Indian home: window, bed, a small Arjuna storybook on the shelf
lines.transitionIn: match (ring frames Arjuna's eye → the girl's eye)
lines.ageCheck: Relatable, safe activity (paper ball into a basket).

views.girl: front close-up → 3/4 facing right, holding the paper ball

lines.text: तो मुश्किल से मुश्किल निशाना भी... आसान हो जाता है!
lines.teachingGoal: Payoff: hard things become easy with focus.
lines.onScreenObject: Paper ball arcs into the basket
lines.howShownVisually: On 'मुश्किल से मुश्किल' the basket looks far (camera stretches the distance). On 'निशाना भी...' she tosses: the ball arcs slowly. On 'आसान' it drops cleanly into the basket; she cheers with both fists up; the storybook Arjuna on the shelf seems to smile. Final hold till the end of the audio.
lines.motion: Ball arc 1.2 s with a soft bounce in the basket; cheer spring
lines.notes: Bookend: lesson lands in the viewer's world.

views.girl: side facing right (toss toward the basket) → 3/4 facing right (cheer)
